title: List Sessions
description: Returns up to `limit` most recent session replay URLs for a user, queried by `uid` and/or `email`. If both `uid` and `email` are provided, this endpoint queries on them separately and returns the union of the records found. It is recommended to use either `uid` or `email`, but not both. Alternatively, provide `session_uid` (the customer-defined session identifier set via the Fullstory SDK or server API) to fetch a single session directly. `session_uid` is mutually exclusive with `uid` and `email`. Pagination is not currently supported; this endpoint always returns a single page.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: The application-specific ID you have assigned to the user (the value passed to `FS('setIdentity')`). Required if neither `email` nor `session_uid` is provided.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address associated with the user. Required if neither `uid` nor `session_uid` is provided.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to 20 when unset.

parameters.name: session_uid
parameters.description: A customer-defined session identifier (the value passed as `uid` when starting a session via the Fullstory SDK or server API). Returns a single matching session. Mutually exclusive with `uid` and `email`.

id.description: The canonical Fullstory session identifier, formatted as `<user_id>:<session_id>`.

app_url.description: A link to the Fullstory app session replay for this session.

created_time.description: The time at which the session was created.

results.description: The list of sessions that match the input filter criteria, ordered from most recent to oldest.

response.description: Server response containing session replay metadata for the matching sessions.
